brief.headline: Push their laminate price from ₹1067.36/KG down toward ₹250/KG — the market fair band and our best price — to save ₹58850 a year

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to cut the LAMINATE price from ₹1067.36/KG to ₹250/KG
priceAsk.basis: That's the price we pay Silk Polypack for the same item, and the market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sits at ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg, verdict MARKET-FAIR top of band). Their current price is 326.9% higher than our best. Closing this gap saves us ₹58850 a year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 days — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki is a large, stable converter with ₹2758.00 Cr in sales and keeps about ₹4.70 of every ₹100 they sell. They carry very little debt (0.11x debt-to-equity) and are growing fast (24.0% a year), so they want new orders. We're tiny — our ₹76850 is 0.00% of their revenue — so we have almost no pull on our own. The play is to dangle more volume (piggyback their growth) in return for matching the ₹250/KG benchmark, and to show them we have Silk Polypack and UFLEX as live alternatives.

evidence.point: Their current laminate price is far above our best and the market
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is fair at the top of its band
We are a very small customer to them
evidence.figure: Our ₹76850 is 0.00% of their ₹2758.00 Cr revenue

evidence.point: They are growing fast and want new orders
They are financially stable with very low debt
Closing the price gap saves us this much each year

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant (₹16492.00 Cr revenue) that makes both film substrate and converts laminates — can second-source at scale

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter (₹222.04 Cr revenue) focused on pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source fit

risks: We're 0.00% of their business — on our own we have almost no bargaining weight; bundle more SKUs or commit longer volume to get their attention
The ₹1067.36/KG price is so far above ₹250/KG that they may refuse to move in one jump — be ready to phase the cut over two purchase orders or ask them to show their cost build-up
Silk Polypack at ₹250/KG may be a smaller, less audited supplier — verify their quality and capacity before you lean too hard on that benchmark in the room
Huhtamaki is stable and growing fast, so they're not desperate — frame the ask around locking in more of our future volume, not as a distress squeeze
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to grow our laminate buy with you, but right now your ₹1067.36/KG is more than four times what we pay elsewhere and what the market asks — let's talk about how we get you to ₹250/KG and commit more volume in return.
